description: This file contains unit tests for the configure_logging() function in the webkitpy project, specifically testing different logging levels and configurations.

classes.name: ConfigureLoggingTestBase
classes.description: Base class for unit tests of configure_logging(), setting up and tearing down logging configurations.

classes.name: ConfigureLoggingTest
classes.description: Tests configure_logging() with default logging level.

classes.name: ConfigureLoggingCustomLevelTest
classes.description: Tests configure_logging() with a custom logging level.

methods.name: _logging_level
methods.description: Returns the logging level for the test; overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up logging configuration for a test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets logging configuration after a test.

methods.name: _assert_log_messages
methods.description: Asserts that logged messages match expected messages.

methods.name: test_debug_message
methods.description: Tests that debug messages are suppressed at default level.

methods.name: test_below_threshold_message
methods.description: Tests that messages below the logging threshold are not logged.

methods.name: test_logged_message
methods.description: Tests logging a message at a custom level.

methods.name: test_below_threshold_message
methods.description: Tests that messages below a custom level are not logged.
